title.narrative: Caribbean Resilient Renewable Energy Infrastructure Investment Facility

description.narrative: The Project Development Objective is to increase the share of utility-scale renewable energy generation in the Caribbean countries.

The objective of the Caribbean Resilient Renewable Energy Infrastructure Investment Facility Project is to increase the share of utility-scale renewable energy generation and private sector participation in renewable energy development in the participating Caribbean countries. There are four components to the project, the first component being Regional Coordination Unit (RCU), institutional strengthening, and implementation support. This component includes two subcomponents: the RCU, the institutional strengthening mechanism; and technical assistance. The second component is the risk mitigation mechanism. The RREIIF will provide risk mitigation solutions for participating banks in the region through a new RE window with partial credit guarantee (PCG) implemented by the ECPCGC. The third component is the RE integration and infrastructure modernization, institutional strengthening, and national implementation support. This component includes four subcomponents: supply and installation of T&D lines; upgrade of substations; and modernization of grid control centers for Grenada, Saint Lucia, and Saint Vincent and the Grenadines; and institutional strengthening and implementation support to National PIUs. Finally, the fourth component is the contingent emergency response component. If needed, this component will be available to redeploy project resources alongside other projects in a specific country's portfolio to respond to an emergency.
